template_data.lead_html: Month eight: the Schedule is live. Now what?

rows.what_html: SAM.gov renewal — miss it and your active Schedule goes on hold
Schedule modifications — price changes, new SINs, each go back to GSA for review
TAA compliance — one supply chain change can open a gap

template_data.closer: THE SCHEDULE IS A CREDENTIAL YOU MAINTAIN.
